title: Airtable website, 2018
lede: Airtable’s 2018 home page: five blue- and pink-skinned figures with long bending limbs climb, lift, and pass shapes to each other beside the heading “Create, your way”.
summary: Blue-skinned, gangly figures stacking and passing blocks and plants beside a plain heading. 2018.

evidence.note: Captured with `tools/capture.mjs` (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. No cookie box covers the page. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.

styles.note: Clear: figures with blue skin, small heads, and long, curving arms and legs lift and pass oversized shapes in bright flat colors on white. A light grain and a few doodled lines on the clothes are the only departures.

notice: The live Airtable site has changed since this 2018 capture.
observed: The heading “Create, your way” is set in a dark grey sans-serif of regular weight, with grey body text, a grey email field, and a blue “Get started” button with small rounded corners.
On the right, five figures form a human tower: one sits on a yellow circle and draws a line with a pen, one kneels on another’s back with a laptop, one lunges to lift a figure above.
Skin is blue on all figures; hair is black; clothes are coral pink, yellow, and blue, some with small white doodles or dots.
Pink and pale blue blocks, yellow circles, a blue triangle, and teal potted plants are stacked around them.
The fills are flat with a light speckled grain; there are no outlines. A pale lilac curve starts the next section, where a purple app window appears.
interpretation: It shows the style’s core metaphor of teamwork: many bendy figures assembling simple shapes into a structure, which also stands for the product’s building blocks.
borrow: Show collaboration as figures physically stacking or passing simple geometric blocks.

images.alt: Airtable home page, 2018: the heading “Create, your way” and an email sign-up on the left; on the right, five blue-skinned, long-limbed figures in pink, yellow, and blue clothes climb on each other and pass blocks, circles, and potted plants.
